results.title: Raphinha treble fires perfect Barca to win at Sevilla
results.description: SEVILLE, Spain: Raphinha scored a superb hat-trick to earn Barcelona a 3-1 win at Sevilla on Saturday in La Liga and preserve their 100 percent record.

results.title: Kentucky upsets Texas A&M with dominant second half
results.description: Unranked Kentucky methodically ended eighth-ranked Texas A&M’s unbeaten start to the season Saturday with a 31-21 victory before 105,186 at Kyle Field.
